quiz.question: What is the purpose of the SEPARATION_DISTANCE parameter in the Boid simulation?
options: To determine which nearby boids to consider for the alignment behavior
To determine which nearby boids to consider for the cohesion behavior
To determine the minimum distance to maintain from other boids
To determine the maximum distance to consider for the separation behavior
quiz.correct_answer: To determine the minimum distance to maintain from other boids

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the ALIGNMENT_DISTANCE parameter in the Boid simulation?
options: To determine the minimum distance to maintain from other boids
To determine the maximum distance to consider for the alignment behavior
To determine which nearby boids to consider for the cohesion behavior
To determine the average direction of nearby boids
quiz.correct_answer: To determine the maximum distance to consider for the alignment behavior

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the COHESION_DISTANCE parameter in the Boid simulation?
options: To determine the minimum distance to maintain from other boids
To determine the maximum distance to consider for the cohesion behavior
To determine which nearby boids to consider for the alignment behavior
To determine the average position of nearby boids
quiz.correct_answer: To determine the maximum distance to consider for the cohesion behavior

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the _separation method in the Boid class?
options: To calculate the average velocity of nearby boids
To calculate the average position of nearby boids
To calculate the steering force to avoid crowding
To calculate the steering force to align with nearby boids
quiz.correct_answer: To calculate the steering force to avoid crowding

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the _alignment method in the Boid class?
options: To calculate the steering force to avoid crowding
To calculate the steering force to align with nearby boids
To calculate the average velocity of nearby boids
To calculate the average position of nearby boids
quiz.correct_answer: To calculate the steering force to align with nearby boids
